blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Cardinal Pablo Virgilio David on Friday urged the Supreme Court (SC) to reconsider rulings affecting the livelihood of small-scale fisherfolk, noting that their rights must be protected. David made the call in line with the observance of World Fisheries Day last November 21, noting that his diocese, as bishop of Kalookan, includes the coastal communities of Malabon and Navotas. READ: Explainer: How a quiet court case threatens small-scale fishers David cited the plight of fisherfolk, including rising fuel prices that make it difficult for them to venture out to sea, as well as the limited fishing grounds available to them.
